question: Can exhaust abilities be activated any time I could normally activate an ability?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: exhaust abilities can be activated any time you could normally activate an ability.
expected.answer: Exhaust abilities can be activated any time you could normally activate an ability.

whyHard: Some abilities are limited to sorcery timing, and players assume exhaust, which can be used once, is one of them.
